review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi description says it is for creating 'JavaScript apps'. GWT (Google Web Toolkit) is primarily for compiling Java code to JavaScript, not for writing JavaScript apps directly. It is a Java-to-JavaScript compiler/framework.
